title: RecordType variants

decisionsAlready.problem: The fields of a RecordType variant were held in a nested field of type `variant`, a structure that JSON Schema does not have, although the SpecSheriff tools check both the nodes and the data records against schemas written in JSON Schema.
decisionsAlready.ruling: The owner: everything about RecordType follows JSON Schema 2020-12. A data record holds the fields of its RecordType variant alongside the fields of its RecordType, as an `if`/`then` pair adds them in JSON Schema. The type `variant` is dropped, and with it the ruling of 2026-10-31 that a data record holds at most one field of that type. The other half of that ruling, that two independent choices are two data records, stands.
